### SPEC.md (verbatim)
# SPEC — Zen 2030 Gestione Documentale & Workflow AWS & on-premise

## Summary
- Slice-1 delivers a cloud-native, single-tenant document management and validation platform on AWS for 5 named users, 20 GB initial storage, and up to 7,200 documents/year.
- The feature scope covers document upload, OCR/IDP prefill, human validation in a web dashboard, minimal workflow with tasks/notifications, searchable archive, controlled export, and generative summary/Q&A on validated documents only.
- The solution must avoid commercial DMS/IDP packages and remain aligned with the provided open-source-oriented stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Paperless-ngx, PostgreSQL, S3, Redis, SQS/SNS, and AWS-hosted AI components.
- The demo target is ready within 2 weeks, with an operational goal of 10 working days.

## Goals
- Enable upload of PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, JPG, and PNG documents via web UI.
- Automatically classify documents and prefill key fields with confidence scores.
- Support explicit human correction and validation before a document becomes authoritative.
- Provide a minimal workflow with task assignment, state transitions, and dashboard/e-mail notifications.
- Store original file, OCR text, metadata, and audit trail in a searchable archive.
- Allow metadata, full-text, and filtered search with preview and controlled download.
- Provide summary and Q&A on validated documents with explicit citations and no autonomous actions.
- Export validated metadata in CSV/JSON with full traceability.

## Non-Goals
- Replace ERP, accounting, CRM, HR, or other line-of-business systems.
- Implement end-to-end accounting approval automation or payment execution.
- Cover all future HR, Finance, and CRM use cases in slice-1.
- Build a general-purpose ECM platform beyond the minimum pilot workflow.
- Optimize for enterprise-scale volumes beyond the pilot targets before value is validated.

## Users & Context
- Primary user: administrative/document operator who uploads documents, reviews extracted fields, corrects data, validates records, searches archives, and handles exceptions.
- Secondary users: IT administrators for platform and access setup; Finance/Administration for audit and controls; DPO/Compliance for privacy and retention oversight.
- Operating context: desktop-first web application in Italian, running on AWS in an EU region.
- Pilot baseline: 5 named users, 20 GB initial storage, up to 600 documents/month in phase 1, and up to 7,200 documents/year.
- Notifications: dashboard notifications are required; e-mail notifications are supported when SMTP is available.
- Human-in-control principle: no document may be finalized or modified by AI without explicit user action.

## Functional Requirements
- FR1: The system shall accept upload of pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, and png files up to 20 MB each and assign a unique document identifier.
- FR2: The system shall persist the original uploaded file in S3 and register initial metadata and status in PostgreSQL.
- FR3: The system shall extract text and candidate fields using parsing/OCR services and store field-level confidence scores.
- FR4: The system shall support configurable rule-based and model-assisted classification for slice-1 document categories.
- FR5: The validation UI shall show in one screen the document preview, extracted fields, confidence scores, and current workflow status.
- FR6: The operator shall be able to correct extracted fields, with storage of original value, corrected value, user, and timestamp.
- FR7: The system shall prevent validation completion until a human explicitly confirms the document.
- FR8: The system shall create a workflow task after upload and track states at minimum for Uploaded, In Processing, Da validare, Validato, and Eccezione.
- FR9: The system shall notify relevant users on transition to Da validare via dashboard and optionally via e-mail when configured.
- FR10: The system shall support search by metadata, full text, and filters, including examples explicitly referenced in scope such as numero fattura, fornitore, P.IVA, status, and period when such metadata exists for the document type.
- FR11: Authorized users shall be able to open a document preview and download the original file according to RBAC permissions.
- FR12: The system shall store and expose a complete audit trail of upload, extraction, correction, validation, export, and status changes.
- FR13: The system shall allow export of filtered metadata to CSV and JSON and log author, timestamp, filter, and record count.
- FR14: The generative assistant shall operate only on validated documents and shall return summaries or answers with explicit citations to source passages.
- FR15: The generative assistant shall not modify document metadata, workflow state, or exports.


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance:
  - P95 upload acknowledgment under 5 seconds for files up to 20 MB.
  - P95 search response under 2 seconds.
  - Archived document retrieval and opening within 30 seconds in 90% of cases.
  - P95 generative response under 20 seconds for a validated document of up to 20 pages.
- Throughput:
  - Support 600 documents/month and burst handling of 50 documents/day without task loss.
- Availability and recovery:
  - 99.5% availability during working hours for the pilot.
  - RPO 60 minutes and RTO 240 minutes.
- Data management:
  - Document storage in AWS S3 in an EU region.
  - Metadata in PostgreSQL 16.
  - Vector storage in pgvector on PostgreSQL.
  - Retention baseline of 3,650 days for transactional/document data and 180 days for logs.
- Security:
  - Encryption at rest and in transit is mandatory.
  - Authentication via OIDC/SAML with MFA.
  - Authorization via RBAC from application groups or IdP groups.
  - Prompt logging disabled; redaction required where AI logs are necessary.
- Observability:
  - Structured logs for ingest, OCR, workflow, search, export, and AI requests.
  - End-to-end tracing via OpenTelemetry.
  - Metrics for accuracy, latency, backlog, failures, and task completion.
- Quality gates:
  - CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
  - Zero critical vulnerabilities in security scans.
  - Minimum automated coverage targets: backend 80%, frontend 75%, AI/RAG 70%.

## High-Level Architecture
- Frontend: Next.js 14 web dashboard for upload, validation, search, tasks, export, and AI assistant access.
- Application/API: FastAPI for orchestration, workflow, audit, search APIs, export APIs, and integration with document core.
- Document core: Paperless-ngx used as the open-source DMS backbone for ingestion/search support within slice-1.
- Processing pipeline: Apache Tika and Unstructured for parsing; Tesseract plus PaddleOCR/docTR for OCR/IDP extraction.
- Storage: Amazon S3 for original documents and derivatives; PostgreSQL 16 for metadata, audit, and workflow; Redis for cache/short-lived state.
- Messaging: Amazon SQS for async jobs and Amazon SNS for notifications/events.
- AI/RAG: vLLM on AWS EC2 GPU with approved local-hosted models, embeddings with bge-m3, reranking with bge-reranker, and pgvector-backed retrieval.
- Identity: enterprise OIDC/SAML IdP when available; demo-time IdP approach remains an assumption to confirm.
- Frontend and backend needs to run on AWS as Cloud Provider and on-premise
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  U[Operatore] --> FE[Next.js Dashboard]
  FE --> API[FastAPI Orchestrator]
  API --> DMS[Paperless-ngx]
  API --> DB[(PostgreSQL + pgvector)]
  API --> CACHE[(Redis)]
  API --> S3[(Amazon S3)]
  API --> Q[SQS]
  API --> N[SNS/Email]
  Q --> OCR[OCR/Parsing Workers\nTika + Unstructured + Tesseract/docTR]
  OCR --> DB
  OCR --> S3
  API --> RAG[vLLM on AWS EC2 GPU]
  RAG --> DB
  FE --> IDP[OIDC/SAML IdP]
```

## Interfaces
- Web UI:
  - Upload documents.
  - Review/correct extracted fields.
  - View task queue and state transitions.
  - Search, preview, and download authorized documents.
  - Trigger metadata export.
  - Ask summary/Q&A on validated documents.
- REST APIs:
  - `POST /documents` for upload.
  - `GET /documents/{id}` for details and audit summary.
  - `POST /documents/{id}/validate` for explicit human validation.
  - `POST /documents/{id}/fields` for field corrections.
  - `GET /search` for metadata/full-text search.
  - `POST /exports` for CSV/JSON exports.
  - `POST /ai/query` for summary/Q&A on validated documents.
- Event interfaces:
  - Upload accepted.
  - Processing completed.
  - Validation required.
  - Status changed.
  - Export completed.
- External integrations:
  - OIDC/SAML identity provider.
  - SMTP/e-mail relay if available.
  - AWS regional services only, due to restricted egress.

## Data Model (logical)
### Entity: User
- id: UUID — primary key
- username: string — unique
- display_name: string — required
- email: string — optional, used for notifications
- role: enum — operator, admin, auditor
- idp_subject: string — unique when federated
- mfa_enabled: boolean — derived from IdP/app policy
- created_at: datetime — required
- last_login_at: datetime — optional

### Entity: Document
- id: UUID — primary key
- external_ref: string — optional business reference
- filename: string — required
- mime_type: string — required
- size_bytes: integer — max 20 MB per file in slice-1
- storage_uri: string — S3 object path
- language: string — default Italian when detected/declared
- source_channel: enum — web_upload
- status: enum — Uploaded, In Processing, Da validare, Validato, Eccezione
- classification_label: string — document type candidate
- classification_confidence: decimal — 0 to 1
- uploaded_by: UUID — FK User
- uploaded_at: datetime — required
- validated_by: UUID — FK User, nullable
- validated_at: datetime — nullable

### Entity: ExtractedField
- id: UUID — primary key
- document_id: UUID — FK Document
- field_name: string — required
- field_value_raw: string — extracted value
- field_value_current: string — current authoritative value
- confidence_score: decimal — 0 to 1
- source_method: enum — parser, ocr, model, manual
- citation_ref: string — optional region/page reference
- corrected_by: UUID — FK User, nullable
- corrected_at: datetime — nullable

### Entity: WorkflowTask
- id: UUID — primary key
- document_id: UUID — FK Document
- task_type: enum — validation, exception_review
- assignee_user_id: UUID — FK User, nullable
- status: enum — open, in_progress, done, cancelled
- priority: enum — low, medium, high
- due_at: datetime — optional
- created_at: datetime — required
- completed_at: datetime — nullable

### Entity: AuditEvent
- id: UUID — primary key
- document_id: UUID — FK Document
- actor_user_id: UUID — FK User, nullable for system events
- event_type: enum — upload, parse, ocr, classify, field_corrected, status_changed, validated, exported, ai_query
- event_payload: json — redacted where needed
- created_at: datetime — required

### Entity: ExportJob
- id: UUID — primary key
- requested_by: UUID — FK User
- format: enum — csv, json
- filter_expression: json — applied filters
- record_count: integer — output size
- output_uri: string — optional S3 path
- created_at: datetime — required
- completed_at: datetime — nullable
- status: enum — pending, completed, failed

### Entity: Notification
- id: UUID — primary key
- user_id: UUID — FK User
- document_id: UUID — FK Document, nullable
- channel: enum — dashboard, email
- template_key: string — required
- delivery_status: enum — pending, sent, failed
